description: This file defines the Manufacturer class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve manufacturer data, list manufacturers, and get layout IDs from the database.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Model class for handling manufacturer data in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves a single manufacturer record by ID, joining description and store data.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific manufacturer.
